_about: SERIES SHELF of one-off translators: the Broadway Library of XVIII Century French Literature (George Routledge & Sons, 1926-1930), edited by Richard Aldington with a general introduction by Edmund Gosse. Each volume's own series list names its translator, so every title here was matched to its translator by that list and the title page, read in the OCR. Because every volume prints the WHOLE series list, the per-title name gate passes trivially and is not evidence on its own. Diderot's Dialogues (Birrell), Crébillon's The Sofa (Dobrée), the Prince de Ligne (Leigh Ashton), the Private Life of Richelieu (F. S. Flint) and the Memoirs of the Bastille (Mills Whitham), first editions of 1927. Aldington's own volume (Voltaire and Frederick) is on the aldington shelf, Emilie Jackson's (Mercier) on emilie-jackson, and Scott Moncrieff's (Lauzun) on scott-moncrieff. Printings before 1931 only. US public domain. Added 2026-10-17 by lane C (round 55); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
